description: Least-privilege capability set for the main window. Deliberately narrower than `core:default`: no plugin grants at all, and no window-manipulation permissions, because every privileged operation (filesystem, process, screen capture, window show/hide) is performed by policy-gated Rust commands rather than by the WebView. Adding any `fs:`, `shell:`, `dialog:` or other plugin permission here is a review flag (AGENTS.md, PLAN 5.4).
